about.title: From first web pages to complex applications.
about.paragraph1: I'm a Senior Frontend Developer specialising in Vue.js. I've been into programming since middle school and have been building web applications professionally for more than six years. Today I develop complex systems for the hospitality and insurance industries, with a focus on clear interfaces and code that is easy to maintain and extend.
about.paragraph2: For the past two years I've been the lead of the frontend team on a platform for an insurance multi-agency. I designed the application architecture, chose the technologies and set the rules we work by. I work closely with the client - I help refine requirements, propose solutions and turn them into concrete tasks, so that technical decisions support business goals.
about.paragraph3: I treat AI as a working tool, not a fashionable extra. I use Claude Code by clearly defined rules, which lets me work faster without losing control over quality. That's also how this portfolio was built, and its code is publicly available. The same approach makes it easier to step into new areas - I'm currently growing towards backend development in Java and Spring.

highlights.lead: I lead the frontend team on a project for an insurance multi-agency. I'm responsible for the application architecture, the choice of technologies (Vue 3, TypeScript, PrimeVue, Pinia, VeeValidate, Zod) and the team's working standards.
highlights.requirements: I work with the client on requirements analysis, propose solutions and plan the team's work.
highlights.prorms: In proRMS, a system that helps hotels manage pricing and revenue, I built a new dashboard from scratch and developed further modules of the application, including Price Optimizer with advanced charts.
highlights.backoffice: I single-handedly delivered the frontend of the proRMS back office - a flexible panel where new pages with forms, tables and charts are built from configuration, without writing additional code.

highlights.projects: I delivered dozens of projects for the company's clients - from landing pages and online stores to websites for property developments where buyers could reserve a unit before purchase.
highlights.delivery: I was responsible for the whole frontend - from faithful implementation of designs and mobile versions to interactive elements and integration with an in-house CMS.

highlights.landing: My first commercial experience. I built responsive landing pages that faithfully reproduced graphic designs and prepared them for PHP backend integration.

privacy.metaDescription: What data incocode.com processes, why, and what rights you have.
privacy.title: Privacy policy

sections.title: Data controller
paragraphs: The controller of personal data is Adam Kokoszka. For any matters concerning personal data, you can write to {email}.

sections.title: Scope and purposes of processing

items.label: Visitor statistics
items.text: I analyse traffic with Umami Cloud. The statistics are anonymous - IP addresses are not stored, and the collected data does not allow me to identify you. It is stored on servers in the European Union for as long as needed to analyse traffic.

items.label: Hosting
items.text: On every visit, the Netlify server processes technical data (including IP address and browser information) to deliver the site and keep it secure. Logs are kept for a short period set by Netlify.

items.label: Email correspondence
items.text: If you write to me, I process your email address and the content of your message solely to reply, for the duration of the correspondence. Providing this data is voluntary, but necessary to receive a reply.

items.label: Cookies
items.text: The site does not use cookies. The only thing saved in your browser storage is the theme you choose (light or dark), which is never sent anywhere.

paragraphs: The legal basis for processing is my legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR) in providing and securing the site, analysing traffic and replying to messages. The data is not used for profiling or automated decision-making.

sections.title: Data recipients
paragraphs: Data may be processed by the service providers the site relies on: Netlify, Inc. (hosting), Umami Software, Inc. (statistics), OVH SAS (email forwarding) and Google (email). Some of them are based in the USA - transfers outside the European Economic Area rely on mechanisms provided for in the GDPR, such as the EU-US Data Privacy Framework or standard contractual clauses.

sections.title: Your rights
paragraphs: You have the right to access your data, to have it rectified or erased, to restrict its processing and to object to processing. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority - in Poland, the President of the Personal Data Protection Office (UODO).
